summary: This clinical trial is testing different doses of a medicine called NNC0662-0419 to see how well it lowers blood sugar in people with type 2 diabetes. The study also compares this new medicine to semaglutide and a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine. Novo Nordisk A/S is sponsoring this Phase 2 study with 270 participants. The status of the trial is currently Recruiting.
